description: Na₂Si₂O₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/a space group. Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.72 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.66 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms.
